p="src/api_client.py"; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("from typing import Any, Callable, Mapping\n","from typing import Any, Callable, Mapping\nfrom urllib.parse import quote, urlencode\n")
old='''        # Values are sent unencoded on purpose: platform-http percent-encodes the query itself, encoding here would double-encode
        query = "&".join(
            f"{key}={value}" for key, value in params.items() if value is not None
        )'''
new='''        # Values must be percent-encoded here: a raw space or "&" in e.g. an account name yields an invalid target (400) or splits the param
        query = urlencode(
            {key: value for key, value in params.items() if value is not None},
            quote_via=quote,
        )'''
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new); open(p,"w").write(s)
EOF

@pytest.mark.parametrize("start_node", [0, 1])
def test_exports_for_account_names_needing_encoding(client, api, start_node):
    api._next_node = start_node
    assert [e.id for e in client.list_exports("Acme Holdings")] == ["e-4"]
    assert [e.id for e in client.list_exports("Smith & Co", fmt="json")] == ["e-6"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("start_node", [0, 1])
def test_reports_for_account_names_needing_encoding(client, api, start_node):
    api._next_node = start_node
    since = datetime(2024, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    assert [r.id for r in client.list_reports("Acme Holdings", since=since)] == ["r-5"]
    assert [r.id for r in client.list_reports("Smith & Co", since=since)] == ["r-6"]
    assert len(api.requests) == 2  # no retries needed


def test_search_accounts_with_special_characters(client):
    assert [a.name for a in client.search_accounts("smith & co")] == ["Smith & Co"]
